	fmt.Println(len(names), len(ages))
}

gotcha.title: Using HashMap like you use Vec
gotcha.looks_fine: In Go, maps are part of the language, like slices. Nothing to import.
gotcha.rust_sees: `Vec` is in the prelude, so it's always there. `HashMap` lives in `std::collections` and needs a `use` line.
gotcha.why: The prelude is kept short on purpose, so your own names rarely clash with std's. `Vec` and `String` made the cut because nearly every file uses them. Maps are common, but not that common. The error message tells you the exact line to add.
